RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, December 3, 2010/Agrahayana 12, 1932 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Communications and
Information Technology; Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution;
Earth Sciences; Human Resource Development; Micro, Small and Medium
Enterprises; Railways; Science and Technology; Steel)
Total number of questions — 20
105
Issuance of ration cards to
eligible persons
*341. PROF. ANIL KUMAR
SAHANI: Will the Minister of
CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND
PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has issued any
instructions to State Governments for
taking penal action against the staff for
issuance of Antyodaya Anna Yojana  (AAY)
and Below Poverty Line (BPL) ration cards
to bogus/ineligible persons;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
number of ration cards cancelled by the
State Governments; and
(c) the action taken to issue ration cards
to eligible poor persons?
Funds to States for implementation
of RTE Act
*342. SHRI KANJIBHAI PA TEL: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Chief
Minister of Gujarat had written a letter to
Prime Minister in January, 2010 for
introduction of Free Compulsory
Education to children as a National Project
by the Union Government;
(b) whether other State Governments
have also written to the Central Government
for providing more funds for smooth
implementation of the Right of Children to
Free and Compulsory Education (RTE)
Act, 2009; and
(c) if so, the concrete steps taken by
Government in this regard?

106
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Complaints of ragging received on
UGC helpline
*343. SHRI BALWINDER SINGH
BHUNDER: Will the Minister of
HUMAN RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of complaints received
on UGC helpline about ragging so far during
the current academic year;
(b) the number of cases out of them,
which have been investigated, with the
findings in each case and the action taken
thereon; and
(c) the number of cases of deaths and
suicides that have happened this year due
to ragging the findings of inquires, if held,
in those cases and the action taken against
students involved therein and the
authorities, if found, indifferent and
negligent?
Universities under consideration for
grant of minority status
*344. SHRI RAASHID ALVI: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the number of universities in the
country which have been granted minority
status; and
(b) whether any other university is
under consideration of Government for
grant of minority status?
Charging of more freight from Indian
farmers
†*345. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of RAILWA YS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that more freight
is being charged from Indian farmers for
transportation of essential food
commodities whereas less goods
transportation charge is being taken from
foreign farmers for the same goods;
(b) if so, the reasons for adopting this
dual policy;
(c) since when this practice of providing
benefit to foreign farmers is going on; and
(d) the details thereof?
Fine Arts colleges
†*346. SHRI ISHWARLAL
SHANKARLAL JAIN: Will the Minister
of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has prepared
any plan to increase the number of Fine
Arts colleges in the country;
(b) the latest rules and guidelines to set
up Fine Arts colleges;
(c) whether it is a fact that there are
only a few Fine Arts colleges in the country
and students are also not showing interest
in Fine Arts;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the details of Fine Arts colleges in
the country functioning properly at
present?
Development and improvement of
railway services in Uttar Pradesh
*347. SHRI MOHAMMED ADEEB:
Will the Minister of RAILWA YS be pleased
to state:
(a) the areas/places in Uttar Pradesh
where railway services/functioning need to
be improved and developed further;
(b) the details of plan, estimates and
preparations made for the same;

107
(c) the targets fixed in each case;
(d) the details of demands received for
development and improvement of railway
services in Uttar Pradesh during the last
year and the current year so far; and
(e) the action being taken in all these
matters?
Workers under the Mid-Day-Meal
Scheme
*348. SHRI TARINI KANTA ROY:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the details of Mid-Day-Meal
workers/cook-cum-helpers working under
the Mid-Day-Meal Scheme, State-wise;
(b) the number of Mid-Day-Meal
workers being paid an honorarium of
` 1000/- per month as announced in
November, 2010, State-wise;
(c) whether Government will agree to
pay minimum wages to these cooks and
cook-cum-helpers;
(d) if so, the time-frame thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Fake letter-pads of VIPs used for
confirmation of tickets
*349. SHRIMA TI KUSUM RAI: Will
the Minister of RAILW AYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether a number of rackets are in
operation in different railway zones,
involved in getting wait-listed tickets
confirmed against requisitions on fake letter-
pads of VIPs;
(b) if so, the details of rackets
apprehended and action taken against them
during the last three years, zone-wise;
(c) whether requisitions received for
wait-listed tickets are verified by Railways
before confirming tickets;
(d) if not, the reasons therefor;
(e) whether non-compilation of
requisitions on the ground of voluminous
work facilitates the corrupt officials of
Railways and fake VIP letter-pad users;
and
(f) if so, whether all requisitions will be
verified?
Implementation of RTE Act
*350. SHRI Y . S. CHOWDARY: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the details of infrastructure,
manpower requirement and cost involved
in implementation of free and compulsory
education;
(b) how does Government propose to
meet this additional expenditure;
(c) the manner in which Government
would meet the additional requirement of
teachers;
(d) whether Government would
encourage private participation by
extending tax relief and through corporate
social responsibility; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Rising tendency among students/
children to commit suicide
†*351. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether cases of suicide among
youth between 15 to 24 years of age have
increased by 200 per cent in last ten years
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

108
and more than four children are committing
suicide each month in Delhi alone;
(b) if so, the steps taken to find out the
reasons behind suicidal tendency among
children;
(c) whether Government would take
any steps to attract children towards out-
door sports; and
(d) whether parents' and teachers'
insistence to turn the children into
superkids has resulted in students falling
victim to mental diseases as a result of
which incidents of suicide among students
are rising?
Investment plans in steel sector in
Orissa
*352. SHRI KISHORE KUMAR
MOHANTY: Will the Minister of STEEL
be pleased to state:
(a) the details of major investment plans
in the steel sector in Orissa;
(b) the progress made so far;
(c) whether Government has drawn any
time-bound implementation programme for
these projects; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Public-Private-Partnership for
Railway projects
*353. SHRI P. RAJEEVE: W ill the
Minister of RAILW AYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether any projects under Public-
Private-Partnership (PPP) have been
started during the last three years;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the ownership of land has
been transferred to any private partner; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Admission of children belonging to
weaker sections in public schools
*354. SHRI SHADI LAL BATRA: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
several public schools have denied
admission to the children belonging to the
weaker sections of society, especially in
Delhi and NCR region;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(c) the details of conditions laid down
for opening of public schools in the
country;
(d) the total number of such public
schools identified for not observing these
conditions during the last three years; and
(e) the details of action taken against
such schools?
Storage capacity of FCI
*355. SHRI K. E. ISMAIL: Will the
Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) the total storage capacity of godowns
owned by Food Corporation of India (FCI),
State-wise;
(b) the total storage capacity rented out,
State-wise;
(c) the total storage capacity hired by
FCI, State-wise; and
(d) the deficit of storage capacity, being
faced by FCI, in storing the procured
foodgrains safely?

109
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Commercialization of education
*356. SHRI RAJEEV
CHANDRASEKHAR: Will the Minister
of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that several judicial
pronouncements have declared that
education is a not-for-profit activity and
commercialization thereof is unwarranted;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that despite
the judicial decision, unaided public schools
are opposing the Right to Education Act
solely on profitability ground;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the action Government proposes to
take in this regard?
Enrolment rate
†*357. SHRI JAI PRAKASH: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has collected
data regarding enrolment rate at secondary
level, State-wise;
(b) if so, the names of such States where
enrolment rate at secondary level is lower
than the national average;
(c) whether Government is taking any
steps in view of these figures, to achieve
the enrolment rate of 70 per cent at
secondary level by 2011-12; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Special package for Vidarbha
*358. SHRI RANJITSINH
VIJAYSINH MOHITE-PATIL: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the demand for any special
package for Vidarbha Region of
Maharashtra has/is being considered by
Government;
(b) if so, the allocation made under the
package;
(c) whether the proposals for
consideration of separate development
boards for Konkan and Northern
Maharashtra have been supported by the
Planning Commission; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Enrolment of Muslim girl children in
schools
*359. SHRIMATI GUNDU
SUDHARANI: Will the Minister of
HUMAN RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) the details of enrolment of Muslim
girl children in primary and upper primary
schools, State-wise;
(b) whether it is a fact that the enrolment
of Muslim girls in primary and upper
primary schools had gone beyond the
national average last year;
(c) if so, the percentage of total Muslim
girl children enrolled during the last year;
and
(d) the efforts the Ministry is making
or proposes to make to enroll more and
more Muslim girls, particularly poor, in
primary and upper primary schools?

110
Cleaning of toxic waste from the
Union Carbide factory
*360. SHRI BIRENDRA PRASAD
BAISHYA: Will the Minister of
CHEMICALS AND FERTILIZERS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is planning to
launch rapid cleaning of toxic waste lying
in the Union Carbide  factory and to
provide clean drinking water to victims of
the world's worst chemical disaster-the
people of Bhopal;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
N
EW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 27th November, 2010 Secretary-General.
Agrahayana 6, 1932 (Saka)

I N D E X
(Ministry-wise)
Agriculture : 358,
Chemicals and Fertilizers : 360,
Communications and Information
Technology :—
Consumer Affairs, Food and Public
Distribution : 341, 355,
Earth Sciences :—
Human Resource Development : 342, 343, 344, 346, 348, 350, 351, 354,
356, 357, 359,
Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises :—
Railways : 345, 347, 349, 353,
Science and Technology :—
Steel : 352.
111
